committee.focus_area: CRUX VARIABLES table and Python falsification suite: verify that acceptance rate <30% and guardrail defect cost > incremental revenue are jointly falsifiable given sparse, censored, and non-i.i.d. observation windows; challenge whether the 10–20 service MVP over two quarters provides sufficient statistical power to reject the null.

Assumption that long-tail teams without pricing analysts will prioritize and action decision-ready opportunity cards over existing ad-hoc workflows, given E8 (unknown decision latency) and E9 (no cost model for false positives) — friction of trust, approval chains, and competing engineering distractions are unmodeled.

Assumption that durable incremental revenue can be isolated from confounding factors (seasonality, competitor moves, product changes, promotion timing) in a 2-quarter window without a control group or matched-cohort design, especially given E6 (promotion ROI not measured) and E7 (churn correlation unestablished).
